settings.question: What can I send you to start a project?
settings.answer: A file, image, sketch, drawing, or reference — any starting point works.

settings.question: How does quoting work?
settings.answer: A real person reviews the request and replies by email with questions or an itemized quote — no automated estimates.

settings.question: Can you help design my part, not just print it?
settings.answer: Yes — design assistance takes ideas from sketch to printable model.

settings.question: Do I need to know CAD?
settings.answer: No — describing the problem is enough. We handle the modeling and walk you through decisions in plain language.

settings.question: What materials do you print in?
settings.answer: FDM printing in PLA and PETG, matched to how your part will be used.

settings.question: PLA or PETG — how do you decide?
settings.answer: By how the part lives: indoors and precise favors PLA; handled, flexed, or outdoors favors PETG. The quote explains the recommendation.

settings.question: How many iterations do projects usually need?
settings.answer: It depends on the part — we scope round by round, so you only pay for the learning you need. Specimen answer.

settings.question: Do you take small-batch or repeat orders?
settings.answer: Yes — from one-off prototypes to repeat production runs.

settings.question: Can you recreate any part?
settings.answer: Only parts you have the right to reproduce, and only where FDM in PLA or PETG genuinely fits — we confirm both during review. Specimen answer.

settings.question: What measurements do you need?
settings.answer: Send what you can — we’ll tell you exactly which dimensions matter for your part. Specimen answer.

settings.question: What do I receive at the end?
settings.answer: A printable design and, where agreed, printed parts. FILE-OWNERSHIP TERMS PENDING

settings.question: What if my idea isn't printable?
settings.answer: We’ll say so early, explain why, and suggest what could work instead. Specimen answer.

settings.question: Are physical products made in-house?
settings.answer: Yes — every physical product is printed, inspected, and packed in-house before it ships.
